lines.text: Look closely at a swinging weight, and you will find a clock hidden inside it.
A young man watched a lamp swing in a cathedral, and something did not add up.
Wide swings and small swings seemed to take the same time.
He checked it against the one clock he always carried: his own pulse.
Today we can watch the same thing through an eyepiece.
And on paper, the whole rule fits in a single line.
A weight on a string had become a way to measure time.
